(b)
Any user applying for a water permit shall submit usage calculations to the director
               of utilities for his review and approval of connected water service tap size, meter
               size and service line size before a water permit will be granted to any user.
(c)
In establishing user demands and design criteria for sizing water taps, service lines,
               and meters, the following publications are hereby adopted by reference: "Sizing Water
               Service Lines and Meters" (AWWA Manual M 22) copyright 1975 by the American Water
               Works Association and "Water Meters—Selection, Installation, Testing, and Maintenance"
               (AWWA M 6), third edition, copyright 1986 by the American Water Works Association.
(Code 1981, § 33-50; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988; Ord. No. 3127, § 7, 10-24-1994)
